title: Doubly Linked List
definition: Similar to a singly linked list, but each node contains a pointer to both the `next` node and the `prev` node, allowing O(1) deletion if the node is known.
simpleExplanation: A scavenger hunt where every clue also tells you where the previous clue was, allowing you to walk backward easily.
